test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 05 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is Option (3) i.e.** 'belong'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Present simple tense is used for general truths; "**belong**" fits this usage.
 
• "**Belong**" agrees with the **plural antecedent subject "Swans."**
 
• Other options are grammatically incorrect for stating a general fact.

Therefore, the correct answer is 'belong'.
